name: kb_promote
description: Upgrade KB entry confidence: UNVERIFIED -> INFERRED -> CONFIRMED. Appends promotion note to content as evidence trail. CONFIRMED entries are no-op. In a MEMBER session over a SQLite project KB only entries tagged member:<caller uuid> can be promoted; any other id returns not-found and changes nothing. Under an http project KB the promote is sent by id with no lookup first: the KB server refuses an unknown, superseded or out-of-scope id itself (a 404 is reported as Entry not found: <id> followed by the server's answer, any other refusal with its HTTP status and the server's title/code/detail), and fleet does not check the member tag. Scope: always the calling session's own KB -- a member session uses its registered work folder; any other session uses the first MCP client root (roots/list) inside a git repository with an origin remote, as that repository's top level, or the fleet server's working folder when the client offers no roots; there is no repo/path scope argument (the removed repo_path, repo and repo_remote_url keys fail with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED). Fails with E-SELF-NO-WORKFOLDER, E-SELF-NOT-A-REPO or E-SELF-NO-REMOTE (each with a one-line remediation) when that folder cannot carry a KB identity (it must be a git repository with an origin remote).
